categories.main_business_segments: Century Iron and Steel Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily operates in steel structure manufacturing and engineering, including traditional steel structures for buildings, industrial plants, and bridges, as well as offshore wind power steel structures such as wind turbine towers and underwater foundations. The company also engages in real estate development, investment, and related engineering services. Subsidiaries focus on offshore wind power equipment manufacturing and overseas steel structure projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced welding and steel fabrication technologies, including ISO 3834 welding quality management certification and EN 1090 steel structure certification. It employs automated production equipment and structural testing instruments to enhance product quality and capacity. Specialized techniques for offshore wind power underwater foundations and jacket assembly are under continuous improvement, supported by professional welders and structural design innovations such as seismic-resistant patented designs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major offshore wind farm developers and operators in Taiwan, industrial and commercial building developers, and government public infrastructure projects. The company serves sectors such as renewable energy (offshore wind), construction of high-rise buildings, industrial plants, bridges, and real estate development. Major clients include Taiwan Power Company and various wind farm projects like the Hai Long and Chang Fang wind farms.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Taoyuan, Yunlin, and Taipei Port. The company also has overseas presence in Myanmar and plans for expansion into Indonesia to serve Southeast Asian markets. Its sales are mainly domestic, with minor exports to Myanmar. The offshore wind power business targets Taiwan's coastal wind farms and aims to expand regionally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Century Iron and Steel operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the steel and offshore wind power supply chain. It manufactures steel components and assemblies for construction and offshore wind foundations, collaborating closely with upstream steel suppliers and downstream wind farm developers and construction contractors. The company also integrates vertically through subsidiaries specializing in wind power equipment manufacturing and installation services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes transformation towards offshore wind power steel structures, focusing on enhancing production capacity and technical expertise in underwater foundations and jacket assembly. R&D efforts include improving welding quality, structural testing, seismic design, and automation of manufacturing processes. It actively pursues ISO and industry certifications and invests in talent development to support green energy and sustainable construction trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through project-based sales of steel structures and components for construction and offshore wind power projects. The company earns income from manufacturing contracts, engineering services, and equipment supply. It also derives revenue from real estate development and investment activities. The business model relies on long-term contracts with developers and government projects, with payments linked to project milestones and deliveries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include China Steel Structure Co., Chun Yuan Steel Co., Tung Ho Steel Structure Co., and Evergreen Heavy Industries in Taiwan. Century Steel is among the top five domestic steel structure manufacturers and holds a leading position in offshore wind power underwater foundation manufacturing due to its unique facilities with heavy-duty docks and certifications. The company leverages its comprehensive supply chain and technical capabilities to differentiate itself in the growing green energy sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$12.47 billion, a 14% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to project completion timing. Despite revenue decline, gross profit and net income increased significantly, with net profit reaching NT$2.36 billion and EPS of NT$6.93. The company’s total assets grew to NT$41.3 billion, and shareholders' equity increased by 64%, reflecting strong profitability and capital structure improvement. The firm is investing in offshore wind power to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Century Steel emphasizes high-quality, certified steel structures with advanced welding and production technologies tailored for both traditional construction and offshore wind power industries. Its unique value lies in its integrated supply chain, specialized facilities with heavy-duty docks for large offshore components, and compliance with stringent industry standards. The company’s focus on green building materials, seismic resistance, and sustainable manufacturing aligns with government policies, providing customers with reliable, innovative, and environmentally friendly steel solutions.
